deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics and is not by Riemann. It is the closing formula of a letter by H. A. Schwarz, which begins on the previous page (folio 37r, dated 'den 25ten').

The visible ink text reads: 'Sagen Sie Ihrer Frau Gemahlin Namens meiner Frau besten Dank für ihren liebenswürdigen Brief und seien Sie mit Ihrer Familie freundlich gegrüßt von Ihrem ergebenster H. A. Schwarz.' In English: 'Please convey to your wife my wife's best thanks for her kind letter, and with your family be cordially greeted by your most devoted H. A. Schwarz.'

The faint mirrored writing over the rest of the sheet is bleed-through from the recto. It is not separate content; it matches the previous-page text (Clebsch photograph, Wöhler, Bogen 20, Articles 18 and 19).

Context from the adjacent pages:
- The letter belongs to the editorial correspondence around Riemann's posthumous minimal-surface memoir. That memoir was edited by K. Hattendorff and published in 1867.
- The 'Hattendorff'sche Redaction' is criticised on the recto.
- The addressee is very likely Heinrich Weber, who edited Riemann's Werke (1876).
- The recto's mathematical remarks on Articles 18–19 concern the explicit algebraic equation for the surface and the plane curve of circle centres as a symmetry plane. Those remarks belong to the previous page, not this one.
- The next page is a separate letter dated Göttingen, 8 Feb 1876. It concerns the counting of constants for the doubly connected (ring-shaped) minimal surface bounded by two convex polygons.

No derivations are present to reconstruct.

results.what: Closing salutation and signature of a letter by H. A. Schwarz (editorial correspondence on Riemann's minimal-surface manuscript, c. 1875/76)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is only the valediction and signature of a letter by H. A. Schwarz, with mirrored bleed-through from the recto. It contains no mathematics and nothing by Riemann himself.
transcription_corrections: The transcription of the visible text is essentially correct: 'Sagen Sie Ihrer Frau Gemahlin Namens meiner Frau besten Dank für ihren liebenswürdigen Brief und seien Sie mit Ihrer Familie freundlich gegrüßt von / Ihrem / ergebenster / H. A. Schwarz.'
The faint mirrored text filling the lower part of the page is bleed-through of folio 37r (the previous page). It should not be transcribed as content of 37v.
The author of this page is H. A. Schwarz, not Riemann; the folio is part of a letter filed in the R.Minimal bundle.
